newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian treasury raises 63 mln dinars at auction.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian treasury raises 63 mln dinars at auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury on Monday said it had sold 63 million dinars ($63 million) of 26-week bills at its weekly auction dated January 14, repaying maturing paper totalling 17.8 million dinars.
The issue was at a 7.8125 percent coupon rate, down from 7.8750 percent last week.
Banks bid for 249 million dinars of 13-, 26-, 52-week and two and three-year paper at between 7.8125 and 8.3125 percent. ($=one dinar)
